cases.given: existing empty private ledger
cases.expected: NO_OPERATION_ENTRY;0 operation,0 legacy,0 total; SHA256(empty); entry null

cases.given: only unrelated valid /1 entries
cases.expected: NO_OPERATION_ENTRY;0 operation; all unrelated entries validated

cases.given: exactly one matching /1 entry
cases.expected: OPERATION_ENTRY_PRESENT;1 operation; detached complete matching entry

cases.given: one matching /1 and unrelated /0 entries
cases.expected: OPERATION_ENTRY_PRESENT;1 operation; legacy count retained; no authenticity claim

cases.given: zero matching /1 and any valid /0
cases.expected: LEGACY_AMBIGUITY;0 operation; no ABANDONED or unspent inference

cases.given: two matching /1 with distinct keys, even equal envelope hashes
cases.expected: CONFLICT; exact multiplicity; entry null; no first/last wins

cases.given: duplicate issuer/envelope key, any schema combination
cases.expected: LEDGER_CORRUPT; counts/hash/entry null

cases.given: valid matching prefix followed by torn/noncanonical/unknown-schema line
cases.expected: LEDGER_CORRUPT; no usable prefix result

cases.given: file absent in existing real parent
cases.expected: LEDGER_MISSING; no file created; counts/hash/entry null

cases.given: missing or non-real parent namespace
cases.expected: LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE; never absence

cases.given: invalid digest type/uppercase/length/value
cases.expected: INVALID_INPUT before any open; operation null

cases.given: valid digest but invalid path type
cases.expected: LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE before open; valid operation retained

cases.given: symlink/hardlink/FIFO/device/directory/mode violation
cases.expected: refusal; never NO_OPERATION_ENTRY; bounded nonblocking read

cases.given: cooperating exclusive writer holds inode lock
cases.expected: LEDGER_BUSY without waiting/creating separate lockfile

cases.given: read/permission/unlock/close failure after parsing
cases.expected: LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE; all provisional counts/hash/entry discarded

cases.given: file size, streamed growth or entry count exceeds bound
cases.expected: LEDGER_UNAVAILABLE with LEDGER_TOO_LARGE; no partial count

cases.given: inspection syscall observation
cases.expected: O_RDONLY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB; no writable/create/write/fsync/repair

cases.given: different ledger bytes with identical operation counts
cases.expected: different ledger_sha256; same descriptor snapshot parsed and hashed

cases.given: mutate returned unique entry then inspect again
cases.expected: stored bytes and next result unchanged

cases.given: observation on any status
cases.expected: closed fields; accepted false; five semantic/provenance/durability fields NOT_EVALUATED

cases.given: unknown expected envelope consumed under a different operation
cases.expected: NO_OPERATION_ENTRY may still occur; no claim of envelope freshness; normal replay check still required

cases.given: new observer output presented to existing envelope-aware resume check
cases.expected: not a substitute; existing APIs/semantics remain unchanged

cases.given: fault-entry/0 supplied operation-only status or added field
cases.expected: reject mixed-version wire; do not relabel weaker evidence

cases.given: fault-entry/1 termination with directly acquired same-op NO_OPERATION_ENTRY/0
cases.expected: ABANDONED claim only after external fault/identity/lock checks; no authorization refund

cases.given: fault-entry/1 termination with directly acquired same-op OPERATION_ENTRY_PRESENT/1
cases.expected: conservative FAILED_CONSUMED only; no acceptance or repaired fault

cases.given: termination finding has legacy/conflict/missing/busy/corrupt/unavailable status
cases.expected: blocked; no terminal record inferred

cases.given: caller-supplied/cached/foreign-operation observation or mismatching full observation digest
cases.expected: not a current acquired finding; termination blocked

cases.given: all existing check/consume/verify/envelope inspection APIs rerun
cases.expected: behavior unchanged; no new default parser/lock semantics

cases.given: legacy ambiguity then attempted automatic migration/guessing by issuer/order
cases.expected: refused; no write or implicit provenance gate

cases.given: external set-aside after terminal finding without expected identity source
cases.expected: still blocked; operation inspection does not supply home identity

cases.given: valid external terminal entry embeds original full observation, then unrelated legitimate ledger append
cases.expected: historical override validates from acquired fault-log snapshot; no equality check to current ledger hash; no fresh authority

cases.given: embedded observation missing/corrupt/hash differs/status-count mismatches or oversized terminal line
cases.expected: terminal write/override refused; no separate invisible observation store or truncation
